blocks.text: DANAO CITY, Cebu, September 30, 2026 — Families in Barangay Lawaan and nearby upland communities will have closer access to health and maternal care with the turnover and blessing of the Barangay Lawaan Health Station and Birthing Center, developed through a partnership between the City Government of Danao and SM Foundation. The newly refurbished two-storey facility occupies a government-owned building formerly used as a multi-purpose building. SM Foundation then refurbished the existing building and provided facilities, furniture, and essential medical equipment to prepare it for patient care. Developed under SM Foundation’s Felicidad T.
